collection_runs_times_ordered.name: collection_runs_times_ordered
collection_runs_times_ordered.value: "collection_runs"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "collection_runs"."started_at" IS NULL OR "collection_runs"."ended_at" >= "collection_runs"."started_at"

delivery_subject_valid.name: delivery_subject_valid
delivery_subject_valid.value: ("delivery_outbox"."kind" = 'collection' AND "delivery_outbox"."raw_item_id" IS NULL AND "delivery_outbox"."revision_id" IS NULL) OR ("delivery_outbox"."kind" = 'normalization' AND "delivery_outbox"."raw_item_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("delivery_outbox"."kind" = 'embedding' AND "delivery_outbox"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL)

embedding_work_reservation_required.name: embedding_work_reservation_required
embedding_work_reservation_required.value: "embedding_work_items"."state" NOT IN ('calling','completed','outcome_unknown') OR "embedding_work_items"."reservation_id" IS NOT NULL

budget_reservation_usage_valid.name: budget_reservation_usage_valid
budget_reservation_usage_valid.value: "provider_budget_reservations"."units" >= 0 AND "provider_budget_reservations"."tokens" >= 0 AND ("provider_budget_reservations"."actual_units" IS NULL OR "provider_budget_reservations"."actual_units" >= 0) AND ("provider_budget_reservations"."actual_tokens" IS NULL OR "provider_budget_reservations"."actual_tokens" >= 0)
